trello.name: Build frontend checkout form using Stripe Elements
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Initial integration within the next two weeks. Build the checkout process using Stripe Elements. Ensure the checkout form matches the app's design and is clean and straightforward. Include a clear comparison of features for each subscription tier (Basic $29/mo, Pro $49/mo, Enterprise $99/mo) with a prominent checkout button. Include a tooltip or help icon explaining what happens if the user chooses a different plan later. Handle potential errors gracefully, such as invalid card details or insufficient funds.

trello.name: Update pricing page to reflect new subscription tiers
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Initial integration within the next two weeks. Update the pricing page to reflect the three new subscription tiers: Basic ($29/month, basic access to AI model selection tool and limited feature set), Pro ($49/month, additional features and priority support), and Enterprise ($99/month, all features, custom support, and integration options). Ensure users can easily understand what they are getting with each plan.

trello.name: Build user dashboard subscription management functionalities
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Initial integration within the next two weeks. Build the user dashboard to provide: current plan details and billing info; options to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscription; access to invoices and payment history; a way to update payment methods. The dashboard should be intuitive, reflect current subscription status in real-time, and notify users of any changes such as successful plan upgrades or payment failures. Integrate the frontend with the backend API so changes to the subscription are reflected in real-time.

trello.name: Integrate Stripe API on the backend for subscription management
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: Initial integration within the next two weeks. Integrate Stripe's API to handle all subscription-related tasks including creating and managing subscriptions, processing payments (handling successful and failed payments), and dealing with webhooks for different events. Ensure the backend handles creating subscriptions when a user selects a plan and completes payment.

trello.name: Set up webhook handlers for Stripe subscription events
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: Initial integration within the next two weeks. Set up webhook handlers for the following events: invoice.payment_succeeded (confirm successful payments and activate or continue the user's subscription), invoice.payment_failed (notify users of failed payments, prompt them to update payment information, and send an email notification), and customer.subscription.deleted (manage cases where users cancel subscriptions, update access rights, and offer a chance to re-subscribe). Ensure handlers update the system correctly.

trello.name: Prepare detailed test plan for subscription flow
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: Testing phase (one week after initial integration, approximately three weeks out). Prepare a detailed test plan covering both manual and automated tests. Include test scenarios to simulate different events like payment failures and cancellations. Cover the whole subscription flow from sign-up to billing to managing the subscription. Share the plan with Jordan and Alex.

trello.name: Implement user notifications for subscription events
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Initial integration within the next two weeks. Handle user notifications for different events such as subscription confirmations and payment errors. If a payment fails, clearly inform the user and provide instructions on how to fix it. Ensure clear notifications are provided during the integration process.

trello.name: Document API endpoints and webhook event handlers
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: Not explicitly stated. Document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers so it is easier to maintain and troubleshoot in the future.

trello.name: Create user documentation and help section for subscriptions
trello.desc: Owner: Not explicitly assigned (team effort). Deadline: Once everything is live. Create a help section or FAQ that covers common issues and questions about subscriptions. Provide clear instructions for users on how to manage their subscriptions, access invoices, and handle any issues.

trello.name: Schedule follow-up meeting for next week
trello.desc: Owner: Alex. Deadline: Next week. Set up a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress on the Stripe integration and address any issues that come up. Team members should reach out if they run into blockers or need help before then.
